adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when no `topic_id` is found it unconditionally calls `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` and then renders `loading` (new code around lines ~12-18). There is no `rescue`/fallback if `Jobs.enqueue` raises (e.g., Sidekiq/Redis client errors), so an exception would bubble up and the iframe request would return a 500 instead of the intended loading UI. This is a robustness/operational edge case rather than a guaranteed functional defect from the diff alone.
